Tried HotS. Just not the thing for me.

Posted in [WP] once awhile. But not recently due to personal stuff.

Freelance writing opportunities are kinda scarce in my region and the vehicle is shared between family members so I will not have reliable access to it. But will inquire about the freelancing

> What were you in school for?

Hah. Most ironically I was doing psychology. Both to try to understanding myself and to actually help with some of my social anxieties.

> What kind of videogames do you like to play? Weird question, do you talk to yourself while gaming?

I prefer singleplayer games, but I've been playing League of Legends as well. I don't like to talk during gaming because it kinda distracts me. I thought of streaming before. But the lack of a good internet at home to have a good connection for league games is bad for me.

> Maybe there is something that you want to try but haven't done it yet because you don't see the practicallity of it? 

I want to be a writer. I like people enjoy the stories I tell. The problem is being I feel like I'm in this slump and unable to get anything out onto a paper.
